name: How much does it cost to build a luxury duplex in Los Angeles?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to build a luxury duplex in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to build a luxury duplex in Los Angeles varies significantly based on factors like lot size, square footage, architectural complexity, materials chosen, and interior finishes. Custom luxury duplexes can range from $400 to $800+ per square foot, excluding land acquisition. This estimate typically covers design, permitting, site preparation, and construction. For a detailed and accurate estimate tailored to your specific project and the local Los Angeles market, we recommend a consultation with Opus Builders.
